description: X (Twitter): upload a local image, GIF, or video via the chunked v2 flow and return a `media_id` to attach with `x_post_create`. The file must live inside the operator-configured media directory. Videos and GIFs may keep processing after upload — poll `x_media_status` until `processing_state` is `succeeded` before posting. Optional `alt_text` adds an accessibility description. (disabled by policy `read-only`)

alt_text.description: Accessibility description attached to the media after upload (max 1000 chars).

media_category.description: Upload category for the composer. Defaults to the one implied by the file’s actual content (image -> tweet_image, GIF -> tweet_gif, video -> tweet_video).

path.description: Path of the media file to upload (image, GIF, or video). Must be inside the operator-configured media directory; relative paths resolve against it.

name: x_media_upload
